purpose: Deterministic composition rules for converting allowed Hero-Soldier relation sources into the final canonical edge set.

semanticPrinciple.finalRelation: Set union of canonical (heroId, soldierId) pairs with provenance merged per pair.
semanticPrinciple.rule: Source production counts may overlap. The same pair produced by multiple allowed paths remains one canonical edge with multiple provenance entries.

compositionPhases.name: DIRECT_BASE
compositionPhases.rule: For each normal Soldier record, create one direct candidate edge for every Hero ID explicitly present in GetSoldierHeros_ID.
compositionPhases.edge: (heroId from GetSoldierHeros_ID, soldierId = owning normal Soldier ID)

compositionPhases.name: DIRECT_SP_HERO_REWARD
compositionPhases.rule: For each SP Hero record, create one direct candidate edge from SPHeroInfo.ID to each Soldier ID explicitly listed in SecondStageRewardSoldiers.
compositionPhases.exactTargetRule: The listed Soldier ID is used exactly as written. If it identifies a normal Soldier, the direct edge belongs to that normal form. If it identifies an SP Soldier, the direct edge belongs to that SP form.

compositionPhases.name: DIRECT_SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND
compositionPhases.rule: For each SP Soldier record, create one direct candidate edge from that SP Soldier to every Hero ID explicitly listed in SecondStageExpandHeroList.

compositionPhases.name: DERIVE_SP_INHERITANCE
compositionPhases.rule: For each explicit SP_FORM_LINK, inspect the linked normal Soldier's canonical edge provenance. For each eligible DIRECT parent provenance of kind BASE_SOLDIER_HERO or SP_HERO_REWARD, create the same Hero relation on the linked SP Soldier as a DERIVED candidate edge.
compositionPhases.edge: (heroId = parent edge heroId, soldierId = linked SP Soldier ID)
ruleDetails: Do not inherit SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT provenance again.
Do not inherit SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND from SP to normal or to another form.
Do not create inheritance when the Normal <-> SP link is missing.
Each eligible parent provenance produces its own derived provenance entry so the original direct origin remains traceable.

compositionPhases.name: CANONICAL_UNION
compositionPhases.rule: Merge all direct and derived candidate edges by exact (heroId, soldierId). Keep one canonical edge per pair and merge all distinct provenance entries according to the A-4 schema.
compositionPhases.provenanceDeduplication: Structural equality of the full provenance entry.

compositionPhases.name: FINAL_VALIDATION_AND_SERIALIZATION
compositionPhases.rule: Validate every canonical edge and provenance entry against A-1 through A-4, then serialize deterministically using the A-4 ordering rules.

normalSoldierFormula.conceptual: final(normal) = BASE_SOLDIER_HERO UNION direct SP_HERO_REWARD targeting that normal Soldier
normalSoldierFormula.provenance: Preserve each direct source independently when both produce the same pair.
forbidden: SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND on an SP form flowing backward to the normal form
relations inferred from the linked SP form

spSoldierFormula.conceptual: final(SP) = inherited eligible normal relations UNION direct SP_HERO_REWARD targeting the SP Soldier UNION SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND
spSoldierFormula.inheritedEligibleNormalRelations: Normal-form BASE_SOLDIER_HERO and normal-form SP_HERO_REWARD provenance only, through explicit SP_FORM_LINK.
spSoldierFormula.directTargetPreservation: An SP_HERO_REWARD that directly lists the SP Soldier remains DIRECT on the SP edge and is not rewritten as inheritance.
forbidden: Treating SecondStageExpandHeroList as the complete Hero list
Propagating SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND back to the normal Soldier
Creating an SP edge from numeric ID offset assumptions

directionRules.sourceNativeDirections: May be Hero -> Soldier or Soldier -> Hero, but are normalized to the same canonical pair.
directionRules.reverseIndexRule: Hero -> Soldier and Soldier -> Hero indexes are derived only after the final canonical union. Neither index is an independent semantic source.

conflictRules: Allowed sources do not override one another; they accumulate provenance on the same canonical pair.
Absence from one source does not negate a relation produced by another allowed source.
No source has deletion precedence in v1; this contract models positive relation evidence only.
If a source references a Hero or Soldier absent from the relevant canonical master, fail validation rather than dropping or remapping it.
If an SP inheritance candidate lacks a valid SP_FORM_LINK, fail/review according to validation policy rather than inferring the link.

baselineEvidence.interpretation: The frozen 3-12 baseline is consistent with overlapping source production and therefore confirms that finalEdges must be computed as a set union rather than by summing source counts.
baselineEvidence.reason: Future client data may legitimately change both source counts and overlap patterns.

builderRequirements: A builder must normalize every allowed source to candidate canonical pairs before final union.
A builder must retain provenance before and after deduplication.
A builder must perform SP inheritance only from eligible direct provenance on the explicitly linked normal form.
A builder must produce the same semantic edge set regardless of source iteration order.
A builder must not use Hero -> Soldier or Soldier -> Hero output indexes as input evidence for additional relations.
A builder must not mutate the frozen stage-3 relation output during A-5; this contract defines the target behavior for the later shared Relation Layer implementation.
completion: A-5 is complete when the final Hero-Soldier relation is formally defined as an order-independent canonical set union of allowed direct and derived candidates, with Normal/SP inheritance direction and provenance-preserving deduplication fixed by contract.
